scenes.narration: Chat is how your team stays in touch between Sundays.
Open Chat. It's the speech bubble on the bottom bar.
A red number on that bubble means unread messages for a campus or ministry you belong to.
Each thread is one campus and one ministry.
If you serve more than one campus, tap the campus name to switch.
Switch ministry on this row. You only see the ministries you are assigned to.
The bottom bar hides in Chat. Tap the home button at the top left to get back.
